title: A thief-app
body:
When you start using the app, it suggests you several variants of payed trial. I chose the 2 weeks one. The app was unuseful, cause it does not allow you to make your on plans, just advices some easy-googled practices (do you really think it costs 50$ a month? I pay less even for my gym, and this app is nothing).

The greatest problem was that I stopped using the app, but today, with no warnings, I was charged for 50$ subscription. During more than 12 hours support did not answer me about refund. And in the bill it’s written that the next 50$ subscription will be in 3 days. Looks like a mistake, but I’m not even sure that 50$ is monthly price.
author: ArinaGugaeva

title: A nice app, but cheating with payment
body: This application requested payment for a trial version of 14 days for $ 10, at the end of the trial period, without my consent, $ 50 for an annual subscription was debited from my card. The application saved the card data without my consent and illegally renewed the subscription. Also, all payments in the Habio application are not displayed in the AppStore and the receipt comes directly from Habio, i.e. the application charges the payment bypassing the AppStore. I can provide all the supporting checks. Also, the manager from Habio refused to cancel the subscription and refund the money.
author: Twitti5
